paper.title: Efficient Solutions of Fermionic Systems using Artificial Neural Networks
paper.authors: Even M. Nordhagen, Jane M. Kim, Bryce Fore, Alessandro Lovato, Morten Hjorth-Jensen

results.system_description: 2D quantum dot: 2 electrons (1 up, 1 down) in a harmonic trap, omega = 0.1 (Hartree units), Coulomb repulsion
results.variant: RBM: Slater determinant of Hermite functions times RBM marginal
results.eligibility_evidence: VMC ground-state energy of the optimized ansatz as printed.
results.notes: Closed-shell dot with N_up = N_down = 1 (the paper assumes an even N and zero total spin, filled shells). Hamiltonian Eq. (1), Hartree units; 'the numbers in parenthesis are the statistical uncertainties in the last digit' (caption). The Slater-Jastrow and Ref. (plain Slater determinant) columns are not neural; DMC and semi-analytical columns are quoted.
